Rear-approach alert system

A driver-awareness prototype

This team project began as a left-lane camping detector and developed into a driver-awareness concept intended to identify vehicles approaching rapidly from behind.

Platform
Arduino-based electronics
Sensing
LIDAR distance measurements
Communication
NRF24 wireless modules
Interface
LCD display
Work in progress

Prototype development in progress.

On this pageProject OverviewDevelopment & Testing
01 / Overview

Project Overview

The goal is to use changes in measured distance to identify rapidly approaching vehicles and show information on the driver’s display.

Development & Testing

Development and testing are ongoing. Detection performance has not yet been validated.
